questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \int_0^3\left[x^2\right] d x+\int_0^3\left[\frac{x^2}{2}\right] d x \\ & =\int_0^1 0 d x+\int_1^{12} 1 d x+\int_{\sqrt{2}}^{\sqrt{3}} 2 d x\end{aligned}\begin{aligned} & +\int_{\sqrt{3}}^2 3 \mathrm{dx}+\int_2^{\sqrt{5}} 4 \mathrm{dx}+\int_{\sqrt{5}}^{\sqrt{6}} 5 \mathrm{dx} \\ & +\int_{\sqrt{6}}^{\sqrt{7}} 6 \mathrm{dx}+\int_{\sqrt{7}}^{\sqrt{8}} 7 \mathrm{dx}+\int_{\sqrt{8}}^3 8 \mathrm{dx} \\ & +\int_0^{\sqrt{2}} 0 \mathrm{dx}+\int_{\sqrt{2}}^2 1 \mathrm{dx} \\ & +\int_2^{\sqrt{6}} 2 \mathrm{dx}+\int_{\sqrt{6}}^{\sqrt{8}} 3 \mathrm{dx}+\int_{\sqrt{8}}^3 4 \mathrm{dx}=31-6 \sqrt{2}-\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{5} \\ & -2 \sqrt{6}-\sqrt{7} \\ & \mathrm{a}=31 \quad \mathrm{~b}=-6 \quad \mathrm{c}=-2 \\ & \mathrm{a}+\mathrm{b}+\mathrm{c}=31-6-2=23\end{aligned}$

questions.q: Let for& $x \in \mathbb{R}, {S}_{0}\left(x\right) = x, {S}_{k}\left(x\right) = {C}_{k}x + k{∫}_{0}^{x}{S}_{k - 1}\left(t\right)dt$~where~${C}_{0} = 1, {C}_{k} = 1 - {∫}_{0}^{1}{S}_{k - 1}\left(x\right)dx, k = 1, 2, 3, \ldots$~Then~${S}_{2}\left(3\right) + 6{C}_{3}$~is equal to~_______ .
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
Given,

${S}_{0}\left(x\right) = x, {S}_{k}\left(x\right) = {C}_{k}x + k{∫}_{0}^{x}{S}_{k - 1}\left(t\right)dt$~

Now for~${S}_{0}\left(x\right) = x, {C}_{0} = 1$

Now solving,~${C}_{k} = 1 - {∫}_{0}^{1}{S}_{k - 1}\left(x\right)dx$~for~$k = 1$~we get,

${C}_{1} = 1 - {∫}_{0}^{1}xdx = \dfrac{1}{2}$

Now putting~$k = 1$~in~${S}_{k}\left(x\right) = {C}_{k}x + k{∫}_{0}^{x}{S}_{k - 1}\left(t\right)dt$~we get,

$⇒ {S}_{1}\left(x\right) = \dfrac{x}{2} + 1 \cdot {∫}_{0}^{x}tdt = \dfrac{x}{2} + \dfrac{x2}{2}$

Now for~$k = 2$~we get,

${C}_{2} = 1 - {∫}_{0}^{1}\left(\dfrac{x}{2} + \dfrac{x2}{2}\right)dx = \dfrac{7}{12}$

And~${S}_{2}\left(x\right) = \dfrac{7}{12}x + 2{∫}_{0}^{x}\left(\dfrac{t}{2} + \dfrac{t2}{2}\right)dt$

$⇒ {S}_{2}\left(x\right) = \dfrac{7x}{12} + \dfrac{x2}{2} + \dfrac{x3}{3}$

Now taking~$k = 3$~we get,

${C}_{3} = 1 - {∫}_{0}^{1}\left(\dfrac{7x}{12} + \dfrac{x2}{2} + \dfrac{x3}{3}\right)dx = \dfrac{11}{24}$

Now finding the value of${S}_{2}\left(3\right) + 6 \cdot {C}_{3}$~we get,

${S}_{2}\left(3\right) + 6 \cdot {C}_{3} = \dfrac{7 \times 3}{12} + \dfrac{32}{2} + \dfrac{33}{3} + 6 \times \dfrac{11}{24}$

$⇒ {S}_{2}\left(3\right) + 6 \cdot {C}_{3} = \dfrac{61}{4} + \dfrac{11}{4} = 18$

questions.q: If ${∫}_{- \pi / 2}^{\pi / 2}\dfrac{8\sqrt{2}cosxdx}{ \left(1 + e^{sinx}\right)\left($1 + \sin^{4}x\right)} = $\alpha\pi + \beta\log_{\mathrm{e}}\left($3 + $2\sqrt{2}\right), where \alpha, \beta are integers, then ${α}^{2} + {β}^{2} equals __________
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
$Given: $I = \mathop{∫}_{- \dfrac{π}{2}}^{\pi2}\dfrac{8\sqrt{2}cosx}{ \left(1 + e^{sinx}\$right)\left(1 + \sin^{4}x\right)}dx . . . \left(i\right)$

Applying ${∫}_a^{b}f\left(x\right) d x = {∫}_a^{b}f\left(a + b - x\right) d x$ rule we get,

$⇒ I = \mathop{∫}_{- $\dfrac{π}{2}}^{\$pi2}\d$dfrac{8\sqrt{2}cosx \left(e^{sinx}\right)}${ \left($1 + e^{sinx}\$right)\left($1 + \sin^{4}x\right)}dx . . . \left($ii\right)$

Adding \left(i\$right)\text{and}\left(ii\right)$

$⇒ 2I = \mathop{∫}_{- \dfrac{π}{2}}^{\$pi2}\ddfrac{8\sqrt{2}cosx}{1 + \sin^{4}x}dx$

$⇒ I = \mathop{∫}_{0}^{\$pi2}\ddfrac{8\sqrt{2}cosx}{1 + \sin^{4}x}dx$

Putting, $sinx = t$

$⇒ I = \mathop{∫}_{0}^{1}\d$dfrac{8\sqrt{2}}{1 + t^{4}}$dx$

$⇒ I = $4\sqrt{2}\mathop{∫}_{0}^{1} $\$left(\dfrac{1 + \dfrac{1}{t2}}{t^{2} + \dfrac{1}{t2}} - \dfrac{1 - \dfrac{1}{t2}}{t^{2} + \dfrac{1}{t2}}\right)dt$

$⇒ I = 4\sqrt{2}\mathop{∫}_{0}^{1}\left(\dfrac{1 + \dfrac{1}{t2}}{ \left(t - \dfrac{1}{t}\right)2 + 2}$ - \left($1 - \dfrac{1}{t2}\right)\left(t + \dfrac{1}{t}\right)2 - 2\right)dt$

Let $t - \dfrac{1}{t} =z$ and $t + \dfrac{1}{t} =k$

$⇒ I = 4\sqrt{2} \left[\mathop{∫}_{- \infty}^{0}\dfrac{dz}{z^{2} + 2} - \mathop{∫}_{∞}^{2}\dfrac{dk}{k^{2} - 2}\right]$

$⇒ I = 4\sqrt{2}{\dfrac{1}{2}\tan^{- 1}\dfrac{z}{2}}_{- \infty}^{0} - {\dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}ln\left(\dfrac{k - \sqrt{2}}{k + \sqrt{2}}\right)}_{∞}^{2}$

$⇒ I = 4\sqrt{2} \left[\dfrac{π}{2\sqrt{2}} - \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\llleft[ln\dfrac{2 - \sqrt{2}}{2 + \sqrt{2}}\right]\right]

$⇒ I = $2\pi +$2log \left(3 + 2\sqrt{2}\right)$

Comparing this value with \left[\alpha\pi + \beta\log_{\mathrm{e}} \left(3 + $2\sqrt{2}\right)\right]

$⇒ \alpha = 2$ and $\beta = 2$

$⇒ {α}^{2} + {β}^{2} = 8$

$

questions.q: Let& ${a}_{n} = {∫}_{- 1}^{n}\left(1 + \dfrac{x}{2} + \dfrac{x2}{3} + \ldots + \dfrac{xn - 1}{n}\right)dx$~for every~$n \in N$. Then the sum of all the elements of the set~\left\{n \in N: {a}_{n} \in \left(2, 30\right)\right\}$ \text{ and } is _________.$
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
Given& ${a}_{n} = {∫}_{- 1}^{n}\left(1 + \dfrac{x}{2} + \dfrac{x2}{3} + \ldots . + \dfrac{xn - 1}{n}\right)dx$

$= {x + \dfrac{x2}{22} + \dfrac{x3}{32} + \ldots \ldots + \dfrac{xn}{n2}}_{- 1}^{n}$

i.e.~${a}_{n} = \dfrac{n + 1}{12} + \dfrac{n^{2} - 1}{22} + \dfrac{n^{3} + 1}{32} + \dfrac{n^{4} - 1}{42} + \ldots + \dfrac{n^{n} + \left(- 1\right)n + 1}{n2}$

Here~${a}_{1} = 2, {a}_{2} = \dfrac{2 + 1}{1} + \dfrac{{2}^{2} - 1}{2} = \dfrac{9}{2},$

${a}_{3} = 4 + 2 + \dfrac{28}{9} = \dfrac{100}{9},$

${a}_{4} = 5 + \dfrac{15}{4} + \dfrac{65}{9} + \dfrac{255}{16} > 31 .$

$∵ {a}_{n} \in \left(2, 30\right)$, so the required set is~\left\{2, 3\right\}$.

$∴$~ sum of all elements~$= 5$.

$

questions.q: If the integral $525\mathop{∫}_{0}^{\pi2}sin2xcos\dfrac{11}{2}x  \left(1 + $cos\dfrac{5}{2}$x\$right)\dfrac{1}{2}$dx$ is equal to \$left(n\sqrt{2} -$64\right)$, then $n$ is equal to ________$
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
Let,

$I = \mathop{∫}_{0}^{\pi2}sin2xcos\dfrac{11}{2}x\left(1 + cos\dfrac{5}{2}x\right)\dfrac{1}{2}dx$

Let $cosx = t^{2} ⇒ sinxdx = - 2tdt$

$∴ I = - 4\mathop{∫}_{1}^{0}t^{2} ⋅ t^{11}\sqrt{\left(1 + t^{5}\right)}\left(t\right)dt$

$⇒ I = 4\mathop{∫}_{0}^{1}t^{14}\sqrt{\left(1 + t^{5}\right)}dt$

Now, let $1 + t^{5} = k^{2}$

$⇒ 5t^{4}dt = 2kdk$

$∴ I = 4 ⋅ \mathop{∫}_{1}^{2}\left(k^{2} - 1\right)2 ⋅ k \cdot \dfrac{2k}{5}dk$

$⇒ I = \dfrac{8}{5}\mathop{∫}_{1}^{2}k^{6} - 2k^{4} + k^{2}dk$

$⇒ I = \dfrac{8}{5}{\dfrac{k7}{7} - \dfrac{2k^{5}}{5} + \dfrac{k3}{3}}_{1}^{2}$

$⇒ I = \dfrac{8}{5}\left[\dfrac{8\sqrt{2}}{7} - \dfrac{8\sqrt{2}}{5} + \dfrac{2\sqrt{2}}{3} - \dfrac{1}{7} + \dfrac{2}{5} - \dfrac{1}{3}\right]$

$⇒ I = \dfrac{8}{5} \left[\dfrac{22\sqrt{2}}{105} - \dfrac{8}{105}\right]

$⇒ 525 ⋅ I = 176$\sqrt{2} -$64$

Hence, on comparing we get, $n = 176$

$

questions.q: If ${∫}_{0}^{π}\dfrac{{5}^{cosx}\left(1 + cosxcos3x + \cos^{2}x + \cos^{3}xcos3x\right)dx}{1 + {5}^{cosx}} = \dfrac{k\pi}{16}$, then $k$ is equal to _____ .
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
$Given,

$I = {∫}_{0}^{π}\dfrac{{5}^{cosx} \left(1 + cosxcos3x + \cos^{2}x + \cos^{3}xcos3x\right)}{1 + {5}^{cosx}}dx . . . . \left(1\right)$

Now using the property~${∫}_a^{b}f\left(x\right) d x = {∫}_a^{b}f\left(a + b - x\right) d x$~we get,

$⇒ I = {∫}_{0}^{π}\dfrac{{5}^{- cosx} \left(1 + cosxcos3x + \cos^{2}x + \cos^{3}xcos3x\right)}{1 + {5}^{- cosx}}$dx . . . . \left($2\right)$

Now adding above equations we get,

$2I = {∫}_{0}^{π}\left($1 + cosxcos3x + \cos^{2}x + \cos^{3}xcos3x\right)dx$

Now using the property~${∫}_{0}^{2a}f\left($x\right) d x = 2{∫}_a^{a}f \left(x\right) d x \left\${\ttext{when}f\left(x\$right)\text{is even}\right$\}$

$⇒ 2I = 2{∫}_{0}^{\pi2}\left(1 + cosxcos3x + \cos^{2}x + \cos^{3}xcos3x\right)dx$

$⇒ I = {∫}_{0}^{\pi2} \left(1 + cosxcos3x + \cos^{2}x + \cos^{3}xcos3x\right)dx . . . . . \left(3\right)$

$⇒ I = {∫}_{0}^{\pi2} \left(1 + sinx \left(-$sin3x\right) + \sin^{2}x - \sin^{3}xsin3x\right)dx . . . . \left($4\right)$

Now adding equation~ \left($3\right) & \left($4\right)$~we get,

$⇒ 2I = {∫}_{0}^{\pi2}\left(3 + cos4x + \cos^{3}xcos3x - \sin^{3}xsin3x\right)dx$

$⇒ 2I = {∫}_{0}^{\pi2}3 + cos4x + $\$left(\dfrac{cos3x + 3cosx}{4}\right)$cos3x - $sin3x \left(\dfrac{3sinx - sin3x}{4}\right)$dx$

$⇒ 2I = {∫}_{0}^{\pi2}\left(3 + cos4x + $\dfrac{1}{4} + \dfrac{3}{4}$cos4x\right)dx$

$⇒ 2I = $\dfrac{13}{4} \times \dfrac{π}{2} + \dfrac{7}{4}{\dfrac{sin4x}{4}}_{0}^{\pi2}

$⇒ I = $\dfrac{13\pi}{16},

Now on comparing with~\dfrac{k\pi}{16},we get~$k = 13

$

questions.q: Let $r_k=\frac{\int_0^1\left(1-x^7\right)^k d x}{\int_0^1\left(1-x^7\right)^{k+1} d x}, k \in \mathbb{N}$. Then the value of $\sum_{k=1}^{10} \frac{1}{7\left(r_k-1\right)}$ is equal to________

questions.solution:
$\begin{aligned} & I_K=\int 1 \cdot\left(1-x^7\right)^K d x \\ & I_K=\left.\left(1-x^7\right)^K x\right|_0 ^1+7 K \int_0^1\left(1-x^7\right)^{K-1} x^6 \cdot x d x \\ & I_K=-7 K \int_0^1\left(1-x^7\right)^{K-1}\left(\left(1-x^7\right)-1\right) d x \\ & I_K=-7 K I_K+7 K I_{K-1} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{I_K}{I_{K+1}}=\frac{7 K+8}{7 K+7}\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned} & r_K=\frac{7 K+8}{7 \mathrm{~K}+7} \\ & \mathrm{r}_{\mathrm{K}}-1=\frac{1}{7(\mathrm{~K}+1)} \\ & \Rightarrow 7\left(\mathrm{r}_{\mathrm{K}}-1\right)=\frac{1}{\mathrm{~K}+1} \\ & \sum_{\mathrm{K}=1}^{10}(\mathrm{~K}+1)=11(6)-1=65\end{aligned}$

questions.q: Let $f\left(x\right) = {∫}_{0}^{x}g\left(t\right)\log_{\mathrm{e}}\left(\dfrac{1 - t}{1 + t}\right)dt$, where $g$ is a continuous odd function. If ${∫}_{- \dfrac{π}{2}}^{\pi2}\left(f\left(x\right) + \dfrac{x^{2}cosx}{1 + e^{x}}\right)dx = \left(\dfrac{π}{α}\right)2 - \alpha$, then $\alpha$ is equal to _____.
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
$Given: $f\left(x\right) = {∫}_{0}^{x}g\left(t\right)log\left(\dfrac{1 - t}{1 + t}\right)dt$

$⇒ f\left(- x\right) = {∫}_{0}^{- x}g\left(t\right)log\left(\dfrac{1 - t}{1 + t}\right)dt$

$⇒ f\left(- x\right) = - {∫}_{0}^{x}g\left(- y\right)log\left(\dfrac{1 + y}{1 - y}\right)dy$

$= - {∫}_{0}^{x}g ( y ) ln\left(\dfrac{1 - y}{1 + y}\right)dy$ ($g$ is odd)

$f ( - x ) = - f ( x ) ⇒ f$ is also odd.

Now,

$I = {∫}_{- \dfrac{π}{2}}^{\pi2} \left(f ( x ) + $\dfrac{x^{2}cosx}{1 + e^{x}}\right)$dx . . . \left(i\right)$

$⇒ I = {∫}_{- \dfrac{π}{2}}^{\pi2} \left(f ( - x ) + $\dfrac{x^{2}e^{x}cosx}{1 + e^{x}}\right)$dx . . . \left(ii\right)$

$⇒ 2I = {∫}_{- $\dfrac{π}{2}}^{\pi2}x^{2}cosxdx$

$⇒ 2I = 2{∫}_{0}^{\pi2}x^{2}cosxdx$

$⇒ I = {∫}_{0}^{\pi2}x^{2}cosxdx$

$⇒ I = {x^{2}sinx}_{0}^{\pi2} - {∫}_{0}^{\pi2}2xsinxdx$

$⇒ I = $\dfrac{\pi2}{4} -$2{- xcosx + sinx}_{0}^{\pi2}$

$⇒ I = $\dfrac{\pi2}{4} -$2 ( 0 + 1 )$

$⇒ I = $\dfrac{\pi2}{4} -$2$

$⇒ I = \$left(\dfrac{π}{2}\right)$2 - 2$

$∴ \alpha =2$

questions.solution:
Let $I=24 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\sin \left|4 x-\frac{\pi}{2}\right|+[2 \sin x]\right) d x$ ...(i)
Now \left|4 x-\frac{\pi}{12}\right|= \begin{cases}-4 x+\frac{\pi}{12} & ; x \lt \frac{\pi}{48} \\ 4 x-\frac{\pi}{12} & ; \quad x \geq \frac{\pi}{48}\end{cases}\therefore$ from $(\mathrm{i})\begin{aligned} & I=24 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{48}}-\sin \left(4 x-\frac{\pi}{12}\right) d x+\int_{\frac{\pi}{48}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \sin \left(4 x-\frac{\pi}{12}\right) \\ & +\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{6}}[2 \sin x] d x+\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}[2 \sin x] d x \\ & I=24\left[\frac{\left(1-\cos \frac{\pi}{12}\right)}{4}-\frac{\left(-\cos \frac{\pi}{12}-1\right)}{4}\right)+\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\pi}{6} \\ & I=24\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)+\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\pi}{6} \\ & I=2 \pi+12=2 \pi+\alpha \text { (from above) } \\ & \therefore \quad \alpha=12\end{aligned}

questions.q: Let $f\left(x\right) = min \left\{  \left[$x - 1\right], \left[$x - 2\right], \ldots , \left[$x - 10\right]\right\}$~where~\left[$t\right]$ denotes the greatest integer $\let$. Then ${∫}_{0}^{10}f\left($x\right)dx + {∫}_{0}^{10}\lleft(f\left(x\right)\right)2dx + {∫}_{0}^{10}\left|f\left(x\right)\right|dx& is equal _______. to$
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
Given,& $f\left(x\right) = min\left\{\left[x - 1\right], \left[x - 2\right], \ldots , \left[x - 10\right]\right\}$

$⇒ f\left(x\right) = \left[x\right] - 10$

Now finding~${∫}_{0}^{10}f\left(x\right) \cdot dx = - 10 - 9 - 8 - \ldots . . - 1$

$= - \dfrac{10 \cdot 11}{2} = - 55$

Finding${∫}_{0}^{10}\left(f\left(x\right)2\right)dx = {10}^{2} + {9}^{2} + {8}^{2} + \ldots + {1}^{2}$

$= \dfrac{10 \cdot 11 \cdot 21}{6} = 385$

And~${∫}_{0}^{10}\left|f\left(x\right)\right| = 10 + 9 + 8 + \ldots . + 1$

$= \dfrac{10 \cdot 11}{2} = 55$

So,~${∫}_{0}^{10}f\left(x\right)dx + {∫}_{0}^{10}\left(f\left(x\right)\right)2dx + {∫}_{0}^{10}\left|f\left(x\right)\right|dx$

$= - 55 + 385 + 55 = 385$
